mission: Make customer-inspectable, reproducible security evidence the highest-priority R&D output for Standment.

senju_collaboration.rule: Senju improves research-process quality and reproducibility. It never receives third-party targets, credentials, exploit instructions, or authorization scope.

tracks.title: Standment Security Scan dogfood + Before/After case study
tracks.hypothesis: Repeated dogfooding on owned assets plus before/after evidence will turn Security Scan from a build artifact into a credible customer-facing case study.
tracks.deliverable: Human-readable scan report, before/after remediation evidence, reproducibility notes and bounded limitations.
tracks.customer_usefulness: A buyer can see what was found, what was changed, and whether the defensive change actually improved the owned system instead of trusting a generic security claim.

tracks.title: Customer Security Evidence Pack
tracks.hypothesis: A standard evidence-pack contract will reduce the distance from verified engineering work to a customer-inspectable security deliverable.
tracks.deliverable: Evidence Pack template covering finding, severity, proof, remediation, retest, limitations and rollback.
tracks.customer_usefulness: Security work can be handed to a customer as a consistent evidence package instead of a loose collection of code, screenshots and engineering notes.

tracks.title: Software supply-chain evidence portfolio
tracks.hypothesis: Combining CodeQL, dependency review, SBOM and security-gate evidence into one reproducible pack will create a stronger defensive security portfolio artifact.
tracks.deliverable: Supply-chain assurance evidence pack with repeatable checks and clear pass/fail boundaries.
tracks.customer_usefulness: A customer or reviewer can inspect dependency, code-analysis and build-chain evidence in one place and understand what is checked automatically on each change.

tracks.title: Auth / tenant / RLS defensive evidence kit
tracks.hypothesis: A fail-closed, evidence-first checklist for owned databases will make authorization and RLS findings safer to remediate and easier to explain to customers.
tracks.deliverable: Owned-system authorization review kit with caller mapping, before/after grants, policy evidence and rollback proof.
tracks.customer_usefulness: Teams can verify who is allowed to access what, see before/after authorization evidence, and reduce the risk of tenant or policy mistakes on owned systems.

tracks.title: Autonomous-agent security and auditability pack
tracks.hypothesis: Explicit action boundaries, evidence trails and independent verification can become a differentiated defensive-security portfolio for autonomous AI systems.
tracks.deliverable: Agent-security architecture note plus auditable run evidence, failure cases and independent verification.
tracks.customer_usefulness: An operator can inspect what an autonomous AI was allowed to do, what it actually did, what failed, and how evidence was preserved for review.
